beforeHooks.title: "before each" hook in "{root}"
beforeHooks.code:
token = await spec()
    .post(URL)
    .withGraphQLQuery(
        'mutation AuthUser($email: String, $password: String) {' +
        ' authUser(email: $email, password: $password) {' +
        ' success' +
        ' token' +
        ' }' +
        '}'
    )
    .withGraphQLVariables({
        email: 'admin@admin.com',
        password: 'admin123'
    })
    .stores('data.authUser.token');

tests.title: deve validar o contrato do addProduct
tests.fullTitle: Contrato - Produto deve validar o contrato do addProduct
tests.code:
await spec()
            .post(URL)
            .withHeaders('Authorization', token)
            .withGraphQLQuery(
                'mutation {' +
                ' addProduct(' +
                ' name: "Contrato Produto M24"' +
                ' description: "Produto para teste de contrato"' +
                ' price: 100' +
                ' specialPrice: 90' +
                ' quantity: 10' +
                ' visible: true' +
                ' ) {' +
                ' name' +
                ' description' +
                ' price' +
                ' specialPrice' +
                ' quantity' +
                ' visible' +
                ' }' +
                '}'
            )
            .expectStatus(200)
            .expectJsonMatch({
                data: {
                    addProduct: {
                        name: null,
                        description: null,
                        price: null,
                        specialPrice: null,
                        quantity: null,
                        visible: null
                    }
                }
            });
